scripts.proto-breaking: if git cat-file -e origin/main:libs/proto/buf.yaml 2>/dev/null; then buf breaking --against '../../.git#ref=origin/main,subdir=libs/proto'; else echo 'no contract on origin/main yet: nothing to compare'; fi
scripts.proto-fresh: scratch="$(mktemp -d)" && buf generate -o "$scratch" && diff -r "$scratch/src/gen" src/gen; status=$?; rm -rf "$scratch"; exit $status
